title: A Light Touch
text: A boy in a cloth cap bumps into you in the crowd and keeps walking a little too fast.

pass.text: You catch his wrist. He trades you a rumor for his freedom.

fail.text: Your wallet is gone, and so is he.

title: Behind the Green Door
text: The speakeasy is loud, smoky, and full of people who have seen things they cannot tell the police.

effects.prompt: Buy a round for the room?

pass.text: A drunk sailor tells you about lights under the water. You write down every word.

fail.text: The room drinks your round and tells you nothing.

pass.text: You listen from a corner booth and hear a name you know.

fail.text: The music is too loud to hear anything useful.

title: The Estate Auction
text: A reclusive collector died last week, and his relatives are selling everything as fast as they can.

pass.text: You win a box of odds and ends for almost nothing.

fail.text: A man in grey outbids you on every lot. He never looks at you.

title: Dark Alley
text: Three men step out of a doorway and block the alley in front of you.

pass.text: You send them running. One of them drops his wallet.

fail.text: They beat you and take what you have.

title: The Reading Room
text: The public library is quiet, and the old newspaper archive is unlocked.

pass.text: Three disappearances, three dates, one pattern.

fail.text: Hours of dust and nothing to show for it.

title: The Charity Ward
text: The nuns at the hospital ask no questions and do not let you leave until you are patched up.

pass.text: You rest properly for the first time in weeks.

fail.text: You slip out before the doctor arrives. There is too much to do.

title: A Society Seance
text: A wealthy widow invites you to a seance. The medium is a fraud, until she is not.

pass.text: You take control of the voice before it takes control of the room, and it teaches you a word of power.

fail.text: The voice speaks your name, and then it laughs.

title: The Night Editor
text: The night editor of the evening paper smokes three cigarettes at once and wants a story.

pass.text: He buys your story and tells you one of his own.

fail.text: He throws you out and calls you a crank.

title: Chanting Upstairs
text: Through the floor of your rented room you hear many voices, chanting in a language that is not Latin.

effects.text: You search the room. Someone left notes.

pass.text: The police raid the room. It is empty, but they find a map.

fail.text: The police arrest the one person in the building who sounds hysterical: you.

effects.text: You find another room across town. You sleep badly.

title: High Stakes
text: A card game in the back room of a hotel. The stakes are high, and one of the players never blinks.

pass.text: You count the cards and clean out the table.

fail.text: The man who never blinks takes every hand. He offers you a loan.

effects.text: You leave with your pride and nothing else.

else.text: You watch a few hands and leave.

title: The Docks at Night
text: Crates from every port in the world sit stacked on the wharf, and the night watchman is asleep.

pass.text: One crate is marked for a man you know is dead. You help yourself.

fail.text: A crate shifts and falls. The watchman wakes up shouting.

title: The Soup Kitchen
text: You spend an evening serving soup to people with nowhere else to go.

pass.text: An old man tells you his brother went into the hills and came back wrong.

fail.text: It is a good evening's work, even so.
